name: Warlords at the Gate: Tower Defense
summary:
Your tabletop becomes a battlefield. Defend the last gate with miniature towers, or take command of the beasts trying to break through. Play offline in a fantasy VR chamber or bring the battle into your room with mixed reality. Optional Room Blend reveals your tabletop between routes and tower pads.

DEFEND THE GATE
